To leverage my specialized expertise in Azure ETL Automation and Python development with web
scraping to drive innovative technological solutions and contribute to cutting-edge data-driven projects.
Highly skilled Python Developer with 5.4 years of comprehensive IT experience, specializing in
advanced Python Django web development and web scraping techniques.

into actionable insights.

performance and scalability.

and Azure SQL. These efforts resulted in a 50% reduction in data retrieval time and improved overall
system performance.

libraries including BeautifulSoup, Requests, and Selenium WebDriver.

ORM.

enabling seamless tracking of product services and insurance.

between models (e.g., Product, User, Vendor, Insurance).
Django REST Framework (DRF): Built RESTful APIs for vendor integration and external
system communication.

sophisticated data collection and processing frameworks.
Advanced skills in Python ecosystem including Django, data manipulation with Pandas, and
integration with various databases and APIs.
Experienced in end-to-end project development, from requirements gathering to deployment, with
a strong focus on creating efficient, maintainable Python solutions.
